_doc: CITED published reranker benchmarks for L7 — NOT computed in this repo. Use verbatim with the source string. The small cross-encoder MRR@10 pair (39.01 vs 39.02) is the teaching punchline: L12 ≈ L6 quality for ~2× the cost. The LLM-reranker nDCG@10 row shows GPT-4 beats monoT5-3B while GPT-3.5 *underperforms* it — capability is not free.
